title: Rochester woman sentenced in $250 million Feeding our Future fraud scheme
notes: Neither the exact sentencing date nor the presiding judge is stated in this article; only the April 1, 2026 publication date and a June 2, 2026 self-surrender deadline are given.
supports: Zamzam Jama was sentenced to six months in prison, ordered to pay $491,245 in restitution, for money laundering in connection with the Brava Restaurant Feeding Our Future scheme.
Jama pleaded guilty in February 2025 (consistent with src-postbulletin-2025-02-05-jama-brava-pleas, which dates her plea to 2025-02-05).
Jama was ordered to self-surrender to her place of confinement, or report to the U.S. Marshals Service in Minneapolis, by June 2, 2026.
does_not_support: The exact date of the sentencing hearing itself, or the presiding judge's name; neither is stated in this article.
A term of supervised release; not stated in the captured text of this article (a one-year term is reported elsewhere but not independently confirmed here).
